quote.quote: NDA 22-268 was presented to the Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee on December 3, 2008.
A meeting of the Anti-Infectives Advisory Committee to discuss NDA 22-268 was held on December 3, 2008.

recommendation.text: The committee voted Yes 18 / No 0 that the 6-dose regimen was effective for uncomplicated P. falciparum malaria, and Yes 17 / No 1 that it was safe for that indication. On the separate question of efficacy/safety in co-infection with P. falciparum and P. vivax (mixed infection) the committee was closely split: Yes 9 / No 8 (one abstention per the CrossR minutes).

summary: The Anti-Infective Drugs Advisory Committee met December 3, 2008 and strongly supported Coartem's 6-dose regimen for uncomplicated P. falciparum malaria (efficacy 18-0, safety 17-1), but split almost evenly (9-8) on the proposed mixed-infection (P. falciparum + P. vivax) indication. As a result, FDA declined the mixed-infection indication and instead added mixed-infection efficacy data to the Clinical Studies labeling section only. Reflecting committee concern about the small number of non-immune travelers (the U.S. target population) and its postmarketing-study recommendations, the approval letter carries a PMR for non-immune travelers and additional PMRs/PMC, including a CDC collaboration on a U.S. observational study.
